``` from sage.all import * from sympy import cbrt from Crypto.Util.number import * load('coppersmith.sage)' c1 = 220063927409019701680780388734859413263649938528559880958114989945319210396443096153070875125175228115415476201776095239222264863 c2 =  c3 =  c4 =  c5 =  n =  e = 3 bytelength = int(math.floor(math.log2(n))) // 8 r =  v = bytes_to_long(b'\x42' * (bytelength - 18) + b'\x00'*18) PR = PolynomialRing(Zmod(n), names='x') x = PR.gens()[0] f1 = (sum([x*256**(18*i) for i in range(28)]))**3 - c4 f2 = (v + x)**3 - c5 m1 = cbrt(c1) m2 = cbrt((c2 * pow(r, -3, n)) % n) m3 = cbrt(c3 * pow(256, -3*(bytelength-18), n) % n) m4 = univariate(f1, X=256**18, m=2)[0] m5 = univariate(f2, X=256**18, m=2)[0] flag = b''.join([long_to_bytes(int(i)) for i in [m1, m2, m3, m4, m5]]) print(flag.decode()) ```
